name: Rhode Island

response.rule_text: Agency must respond or deny in writing with reasons and appeal procedures within ten business days (§§ 38-2-3(e), 38-2-7); failure is deemed a denial (§ 38-2-7(b)). For good cause the period may be extended, capped at 30 business days total per RCFP.

fees.labor_rule: Reasonable search and retrieval charge capped at $15 per hour with the first hour free (§ 38-2-4(b)).
fees.copy_rule: Up to $0.15 per page for standard-size paper (§ 38-2-4(a)).
fees.waiver_rule: Court may reduce or waive search/retrieval fees in the public interest (§ 38-2-4(e); § 38-2-9(d)).
fees.estimate_required: Estimates and itemized costs available on request (§ 38-2-4(c)-(d)).
fees.late_penalty: Fees waived if records not produced within ten business days (RCFP, citation garbled).

residency.rule_text: Every person or entity may request records (§ 38-2-3(a)); purpose cannot justify withholding.

appeal.body: Agency chief administrative officer, then Attorney General complaint or Superior Court
appeal.rule_text: Appeal to the agency's chief administrative officer, who decides within ten business days (§ 38-2-8(a)); then complaint to the AG or suit in Superior Court of the county where records are kept (§ 38-2-8(b)). No APRA filing deadline stated; initial denial counts as exhaustion.

format_rule: Requester may choose any media the agency can provide (§ 38-2-3(g)); no duty to compile or reorganize data (§ 38-2-3(h)).
notes: Read chars 0-200k. Executive branch covered without limit but governor not named. Courts covered only for administrative functions. extension_days left null because RCFP states a 30-business-day cap, ambiguous whether total or additional. Universities not directly addressed.
